_note: UCI / UC Recruit overrides. Layer on top of a base profile: -d applicants/test.json -d applicants/uci_overrides.json. UC Recruit sign-in is PASSWORDLESS (magic link by email) — there is no account password. What matters is emails.institution_email: set it to an address whose inbox you can read over IMAP, because the `await_email_link` step opens the verification link sent there. A Gmail +alias (e.g. yourname+uci@gmail.com) is ideal. Provide IMAP creds via env vars before running: IMAP_USER, IMAP_PASSWORD (a Gmail APP password), optional IMAP_HOST.
